regimes.HEALTHY UPTREND: The market is steadily rising with low volatility and broad participation across sectors. A safe environment for long positions.
regimes.DISTRIBUTION PHASE: The market remains near its highs, but smart money is secretly selling into strength. Volatility is rising beneath the surface.
regimes.CRASH OPPORTUNITY: Absolute panic and capitulation. The market is flashing a rare, high-conviction contrarian buying opportunity.
regimes.DANGEROUS DOWNTREND: The market is in a sustained decline characterized by lower highs and lower lows. Cash is the safest position.
regimes.ACCUMULATION PHASE: Deep fear is subsiding, and institutional investors are quietly buying high-quality assets at discounted prices.
regimes.SIDEWAYS RANGE: The market is trendless, chopping back and forth between support and resistance as it awaits a macro catalyst.

setups.EXHAUSTED OVERSOLD: Sellers are entirely depleted. An extreme mechanical bounce is highly probable.
setups.OVERSOLD: The asset is trading well below its recent historical average, offering a good entry zone.
setups.NEUTRAL / MEAN: Price is resting near its average. There is no clear momentum edge in either direction.
setups.OVERBOUGHT: The asset has rallied too far, too fast. A short-term pullback is likely.
setups.BLOW-OFF TOP: A euphoric buying climax. It is extremely dangerous to chase prices at these levels.
setups.BEARISH DIVERGENCE: Price is making new highs, but underlying momentum and participation are failing.

directions.RISK ON: A majority of the underlying signals (trend, breadth, volatility, rates) agree conditions currently favor risk-taking.
directions.RISK OFF: A majority of the underlying signals agree conditions currently favor caution or defensive positioning.
directions.MIXED: The underlying signals are split, with no clear majority favoring either risk-on or risk-off conditions.

cycle_zones.EXPANSION ZONE: The same underlying signal behind a RISK ON read: a majority of the underlying signals (trend, breadth, volatility, rates) agree conditions currently favor risk-taking.
cycle_zones.CONTRACTION ZONE: The same underlying signal behind a RISK OFF read: a majority of the underlying signals agree conditions currently favor caution or defensive positioning.
cycle_zones.TRANSITION ZONE: The same underlying signal behind a MIXED read: the underlying signals are split, with no clear majority favoring either risk-on or risk-off conditions.

actions.STRONG BUY: Extreme capitulation detected. High probability of a mechanical bounce.
actions.ACCUMULATE: Market is cooling off. Good zone for dollar-cost averaging.
actions.NEUTRAL: Market is balanced. Hold current positions.
actions.CAUTION: Market is heavily extended. Consider trimming profits or tightening stops.
actions.STRONG SELL: Euphoria and overbought technicals. High probability of a violent pullback.
